name: Signal Cluster S55: Percentile Rank Normalization
description: Tests: percentrank(period). Relative volume detection, adaptive thresholds, indicator normalization to 0-100.
source:
# =============================================================================
# SIGNAL CLUSTER S55: Percentile Rank
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c
volume = src.v

# === RELATIVE VOLUME ===
rel_vol = percentrank(volume, 50)
high_volume = rel_vol > 90

# === INDICATOR NORMALIZATION ===
rsi_val = rsi(close, 14)
rsi_percentile = percentrank(rsi_val, 252)

# === ADAPTIVE THRESHOLD ===
# Instead of fixed RSI > 70, use adaptive percentile
rsi_extreme = rsi_percentile > 95

# === REPORTERS ===
xy_lines(
    title='Relative Volume Percentile',
    category='Volume',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Vol Percentile', color=Color.Orange)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=90.0, title='High Vol', color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=rel_vol)

xy_lines(
    title='RSI Percentile (adaptive)',
    category='RSI',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='RSI Percentile', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=95.0, title='Extreme', color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        ReferenceLine(value=5.0, title='Extreme Low', color=Color.Green, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=rsi_percentile)

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        icon=Icon.ActivityIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Volume', dp=0, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(title='Percentile', dp=0, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ],
        title='High Volume Day (>90th pctile)'
    )
)(volume, rel_vol, high_volume)
